messages:
Maya: Huge thanks to @Aj and @Liam — they pulled an emergency fix on model routing for the NorthStar demo this morning. Customer call went from panic to applause :sparkles:
Aj: No biggie, we just rerouted the request path and forced a graceful fallback when the larger model hit OOM. Jen also spotted the error pattern in the logs and pointed us to the bad shard. :muscle:
Liam: shouts to Jen + CloudInfra for the capacity bump. late-night coffee + tiny scripts saved the day :coffee: :tada:
Jen: Glad it helped! I left a short note in #eng-runtime and will open a runbook PR to capture the steps (auto-fallback on model mismatch).
Maya: adding a literal bagel run to next week's retro as payment — who wants sesame? :bagel: :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed at 07:12 UTC by @Aj — status: success.
Aj: Also big props to @CloudInfra for the quick quota increase. Wouldn't have been possible without that extra headroom.
CloudInfra: happy to help — ping us in #eng-infra next time and we'll pre-authorize a fast bump. :)
Liam: Teamwork makes demos look magical. tl;dr: Aj + Liam + Jen + infra = demo saved. :sparkles: :heart:
Maya: Official kudos emoji cascade from me :confetti_ball: — thanks everyone!
(reacted :tada: by Maya, :heart: by Jen)
